slots.jd.school-district.about: The Ashgrove Unified School District seeks a Classroom Teacher for on-site work at a district school in Ashgrove. Under the general direction of the building principal, the Classroom Teacher plans and delivers instruction for an assigned class, keeps a safe and orderly learning environment, assesses student progress, and keeps families informed. The position works closely with grade-level colleagues and school support staff.
slots.jd.school-district.duties:
Responsibilities of the position
- Plan and deliver daily lessons aligned with district curriculum standards.
- Lead small-group reading sessions that match texts and tasks to each student's current level.
- Hold parent conferences to review student progress, set goals and agree on next steps.
- Take part in team planning with grade-level colleagues to align lessons, assessments and classroom routines.
- Assess student learning regularly and adjust instruction based on the results.
- Keep accurate records of attendance, grades and family contacts.
slots.jd.school-district.needs:
Qualifications and conditions of employment
- At least 4 years of experience as a classroom teacher.
- Classroom management and parent communication skills that support a calm, well-run classroom and steady contact with families.
- Differentiated instruction, including the use of math manipulatives to teach concepts.
- Phonics instruction and reading intervention for students who need extra support.
- Reading Specialist Endorsement required.
- Instructional Leadership Endorsement preferred.

slots.r1.b4: Plans daily math lessons with math manipulatives so students model each problem with objects before moving to written work.

slots.r1.i2: Leads a full elementary class at Hillcrest Elementary School and checks student progress often to decide what each child needs next.
slots.r2.b1: Led small-group reading using differentiated instruction, raising the share of students reading at grade level by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Planned with grade-level colleagues to apply the same behavior supports across classrooms so students met consistent expectations.

slots.summary.1: Elementary classroom teacher with about 4 years of experience who runs a full class independently, from lesson design to family contact. Uses Nearpod, behavior supports and math manipulatives to keep instruction active and students on task.
slots.summary.2: Licensed elementary teacher holding a Reading Specialist Endorsement, with about 4 years of classroom experience and full responsibility for a class without close supervision. Combines behavior supports, math manipulatives and Nearpod lessons to meet varied student needs.
